# Weir Here Staffing Solutions

Weir Here Staffing Solutions is a healthcare and domestic staffing agency headquartered in Mandeville, Jamaica, serving local and international clients.

## Company Overview

- **Founded:** 2024
- **Headquarters:** 7 Rosedale Drive, Mandeville, Jamaica
- **Google Maps:** https://www.google.com/maps?cid=9587684291007895327
- **Google Reviews:** https://g.page/r/CQ8lznbU83CYEBM/review
- **Phone:** +1 (876) 566-9428
- **Email:** info@weirheresolutions.com
- **Website:** https://weirheresolutions.com
- **WhatsApp:** +1 (876) 566-9428

## Mission

To connect qualified, compassionate healthcare professionals and domestic workers with the facilities, families, and organizations that need them most — built on integrity, innovation, and personalized service. *When you need us, Weir Here.*

## Leadership

- **Carla Brannon** — Chief Executive Officer: 20+ years of leadership experience in healthcare operations, workforce management, and organizational transformation. BA in Law and Society from Penn State University; graduate studies in Law and Business Management.
- **Patsy Weir** — Chief Financial Officer: Expertise in financial planning, compliance, multi-company financial management, and strategic scaling.

## Services

### Healthcare Staffing
- Registered Nurses (RNs) — all specialties, flexible shifts
- Licensed Practical Nurses (LPNs) — acute care, long-term care, clinics
- Geriatric Nurses — specialized long-term and elder care
- Physicians & Advanced Practice Providers — board-certified, locum & permanent
- Medical Professionals — general clinical and allied health

### Domestic & Care Staffing
- Domestic Care Aides — in-home support for seniors and individuals with special needs
- Certified Babysitters — pediatric-trained caregivers
- Housekeeping — professional vetted cleaning staff
- Tutoring — qualified tutors in Math, Science, English, and more

### Business Solutions
- Employer Hiring Solutions — temporary, contract-to-hire, permanent placements
- Job Seeker Placement — free career matching service
- Travel & Temporary Staffing — short-term and locum assignments
- Support Staff — administrative, clerical, and front-office roles

## Geographic Coverage

Primarily serves Kingston, Jamaica and surrounding parishes. Also facilitates international travel staffing and placements for the Jamaican diaspora.
